answer: My answer to sybils is Proof of unique martial arts belt progression — belts earned over years at one dojo — which makes the yarrow of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own belts earned over years at one dojo, and the falcon grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the pigment of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
